personal.name: Favour Oti
personal.title: SOFTWARE ENGINEER
personal.bio: I build production web and mobile apps across travel, hospitality, EV, and enterprise supply chain, with clean code, solid tests, and thoughtful design.
personal.aboutText: I'm a software engineer pursuing my Master's in Software Engineering at Carleton University. I build performant, accessible web and mobile applications that solve real problems across travel tech, hospitality, EV, and enterprise supply chain platforms. I care about clean architecture, strong test coverage, smooth interactions, and writing code that other developers enjoy working with.

experience.description: Investigated and fixed bugs in Maestro, an enterprise supply-chain planning product, navigating a large established codebase alongside senior engineers. Strengthened coverage with Playwright end-to-end and Jest unit tests, and used AI coding tools to speed up debugging and code comprehension.

Build production web apps for travel and hospitality clients, including Kinnect (54+ African countries) and Revibe, with reusable components, admin dashboards, and a shared state architecture across Redux Toolkit and TanStack Query. Review pull requests and ship mobile-first, responsive features.

Built a Flutter/Dart mobile app for an EV rental marketplace with booking for vehicles and charging, integrated the Paystack payment API across customer and merchant flows, and added Google Maps for location tracking. Also shipped React features for the company website.
Redesigned the payment checkout flow to improve the user experience and built responsive client websites, integrating REST APIs and contributing smaller backend features in Laravel.
